# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 32
- **Additions**: +4257
- **Deletions**: -4
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:58Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 32
- **Additions**: +4257
- **Deletions**: -4
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:58Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

# pr-1563: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)

## Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).

- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

### Thread 26 — `lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-12):
💡 **SUGGESTION (non-blocking, carried from the previous round): oversized claude files vanish at discovery instead of refusing with the counted warning omp produces**

`f12f25180` froze the harness sets (`Set.unmodifiable`) and fixed both TUI test premises — thank you. This one suggestion remains open (fine to defer): when a claude file exceeds `maxFileBytes`, `_firstCwd` returns `''`, the cwd-match fails, and the file never becomes a summary — so `fa import --all` reports `no claude sessions found` instead of omp's `warning: skipped <id>: file too large`.

Pathological input only (512 MiB), so this is a reporting-parity nit: if you want it, let discovery include the summary (sentinel cwd) and let `scanForeignLines`' read-time refusal produce the counted warning, like omp. Not a merge blocker — noting it here so it survives the AC7 spike where claude shapes get revisited anyway.

---

### Thread 27

**vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit** (2026-10-12):

1. **SessionMetadata ×4** — type lives in `lib/src/session/session_storage.dart:58` (`final class SessionMetadata`), not in the two modules import_runner imported. Fix: `import '../session/session_storage.dart';` (import_runner.dart:12). Grep: `final class SessionMetadata` → session_storage.dart:58; all 3 uses now at import_runner.dart:160,164,180.
2. **`FileSystem.readRange` undefined ×3** — `readRange` is declared only on `RangedReadFileSystem` (execution_env.dart:264), which does not extend `FileSystem`, so `fs is RangedReadFileSystem` checks do not promote. Fix (PR#1458-style explicit bind): `final ranged = fs as RangedReadFileSystem;` after each guarded is-check, calls now `ranged.readRange(...)` at harness_adapter.dart:138, claude_adapter.dart:196, omp_adapter.dart:221. Grep: `readRange` declared at execution_env.dart:264; zero remaining `fs.readRange` in the diff.
3. **member 'dir' not found ×3** — real `FileKind` values are `file`/`directory`/`symlink` (execution_env.dart:72-78). Fix: `FileKind.dir` → `FileKind.directory` at claude_adapter.dart:36, omp_adapter.dart:35,54. Grep: `enum FileKind` block read; zero remaining `FileKind.dir` outside `.directory`.
4. **agent_cli.dart:1003 void-where-Future** — `openImportHarnessPickerForTest() => _openImportHarnessPicker();` returned a void expression. Fix: `async { _openImportHarnessPicker(); }` (agent_cli.dart:1003-1005).
5. **buildImportSessionsMenu param mismatch** — the field existed (fa_tui.dart:151) but the `FaTuiCallbacks` constructor lacked the named param. Fix: `this.buildImportSessionsMenu,` added to the ctor (fa_tui.dart:114); the repl_boot call site now resolves.

# pr-1563: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)

## Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 32
- **Additions**: +4257
- **Deletions**: -4
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:58Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1563
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1563
- **Title**: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1562-fa-import` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 32
- **Additions**: +4257
- **Deletions**: -4
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:05:01Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T05:56:58Z

## PR Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

## Verification disclosure (honest)
This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). Fallback per lane discipline:
- a full compiler-style static pass over every new/modified file — every referenced symbol traced to a definition or import, directive order checked, and every call on typed interfaces (FileSystem, RangedReadFileSystem, HarnessAdapter, Session, JsonlSessionRepo) verified against the actual interface members;
- the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

Security invariants (AC11): no LLM config anywhere in the import path; FA paths derive only from fa's own uuid + slug encoder; foreign stores opened read-only (byte-identity asserted by REG-5); stdout carries ids/counts only.

## Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).

# pr-1563: feat(1562): fa import — cross-harness session importer (omp+claude adapters, CLI, /import TUI)

## Description

Closes #1562.

## What lands (v1 per the GOAL card)

**Adapters (lib/src/import/)** — foreign stores are read-only, always:
- omp_adapter.dart — bucket discovery by **slug compare + header cwd** (never decodes a slug, E12; absolute + home-relative + tmp omp slug forms), 256-byte title slot **and** legacy inline-header title (E1), camelCase role taxonomy, toolCallId toolResult pairing with orphan-to-custom (AC5), bounded embed-or-skip blob images against ~/.omp/agent/blobs/<hash> (1 MiB default, E5), sidecar artifacts dirs + .jsonl.tombstone never imported (E2), two-pass leaf-path read (tree skeleton pass then active-branch pass) with corrupt/oversized line skip-with-count (E10) and a 512 MiB file-cap refusal before any read (E11).
- claude_adapter.dart — parentUuid main-chain import, isSidechain excluded+counted (AC8/E13), tool_result blocks lifted into toolResult records (omp-parity pairing), last-prompt/permission-mode/hook attachments as inert customs (C2; full taxonomy stays open for the AC7 spike).
- import_mapper.dart — the **pure** ForeignRecord-to-FA append-plan mapper (UT-covered, no IO): titles newest-wins/user-preferred with first-user-message fallback (F5 pin), text/thinking/toolCall/image blocks onto the FA message union, usage/stopReason best-effort onto FA slots with field-level drops counted, compaction summary verbatim with foreign optional fields counted (foreign firstKeptEntryId cannot resolve inside the FA file, so it lands empty — disclosed below), custom/custom_message preserve the foreign customType **byte-exact** inside data, every unmapped type/role lands as an import.<harness>.<type> inert custom, never a raw line (AC6/M-invariant).
- import_runner.dart — dedupe marker importedFrom{harness,sourcePath,sourceId,recordCount} in the FA header (F12), re-import skips (AC10/E6), kill-mid-import detection via a final import.<harness>.complete record so an importer-owned incomplete file is replaced on retry (E14), exit codes 0/1/2/3 per the GOAL table, stdout carries ids/counts only (AC11).

**CLI** — fa import --harness=<omp|kimi|opencode|claude> (--all | --session=<id|prefix>) [--session-root=...] [--cwd=...], both "--flag value" and "--flag=value" forms; strict parse (unknown flag/harness, missing/conflicting selector become usage errors, F7); intercepted in fah_runapp before any provider wiring — **zero** provider/model/key config (F8, trajectory precedent). Import usage errors exit **1** (GOAL exit table) instead of the repo's EX_USAGE 64 — a deliberate, commented deviation at the parse catch site. kimi/opencode parse and answer with the expected store path + pending-spike note (exit 2) until their AC7 spike.

**TUI** — /import in the slash menu + help: harness picker (import-harness, 4 entries) then the session-search picker (import-sessions) with "All (n sessions)" plus per-session rows carrying title and 160-char-capped first/last previews (F11), keyword search over session **content** through the host-callback rebuild mechanism (the models-picker mechanism, F10 — FaTuiCallbacks.buildImportSessionsMenu), Esc-safe at every step. Both ids registered in _tuiPickerHandlers; the exact-id dispatch test set extended (REG-1).

## Implementation-time pins (card-licensed, minimal)
- Bounds: 512 MiB per file / 16 MiB per line / 1 MiB per image blob / 64 KiB search index per session (ImportLimits, injectable for tests).
- Unnamed sessions fall back to an 80-char-capped first-user-message prefix.
- omp model_change.model lands verbatim as FA modelId with the provider prefix split (zai/glm-5.3 gives provider zai, modelId zai/glm-5.3).
- Imported compaction records: summary verbatim; firstKeptEntryId/tokensBefore dropped-with-count (foreign record ids do not exist in the FA file; pre-compaction history stays in the file and the verbatim summary carries it — the same semantics the foreign session itself had after compaction).
- developer role maps to a user message; bashExecution/pythonExecution/fileMention/hookMessage map to inert customs.
- claude block shapes (tool_use/tool_result/thinking/base64 source) implemented from the public claude-code JSONL shape — synthetic committed fixtures until the AC7 spike pins real samples.
- TUI /import passes an empty tempDir into the omp slug candidates (the lib stays dart:io-free); the CLI passes the real system temp dir, so /tmp-rooted omp projects are discovered via the CLI form.

## Test matrix (tiered per the card)
- **UT** test/import/omp_adapter_test.dart (slugs, header cwd, title slot vs legacy, blob present/missing, corrupt/oversized lines, sidecars+tombstones, size refusal, branch selection) and import_mapper_test.dart (REG-4 golden sequence, AC4/AC5/AC6, E3/E4, byte-exact customType, claude AC8/E13).
- **IT** import_runner_test.dart (AC1 bucket + repo.list + trajectory render + F12 marker; AC2 --all + idempotent rerun; E7 exit 2; E8 exit 3; E9/E9b; E10; E14 replace-on-retry; AC9 tiny-cap refusal; REG-5 foreign-store byte-identity + home-tree snapshot; AC11 stdout byte-scan) and import_tui_test.dart (picker items, pending-spike answer, previews + content keyword search via the rebuild callback, one/all import through the real runner).
- **REG** REG-1 extended in test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart; REG-3 help guard in import_cli_args_test.dart; /import classified in cli_parity_test.dart.
- **E2E** import_e2e_machine_test.dart — machine-gated (FA_IMPORT_E2E=1 plus a real ~/.omp store), read-only against the real store, skipped otherwise.

This lane runs on the agents Mac where the owner's LLM loop holds the box: **the Dart VM is SIGKILLed at startup (exit 137) — dart --version itself dies**, so pub get, dart analyze, and dart test could not be executed even once (confirmed on the raw flutter-cache SDK binary, not just the shim). - the layer's types were cross-checked against the pinned sources the card cites (session_record.dart, session_repo.dart, session_tree.dart, session_storage.dart, cli_args.dart, pickers/TUI).

**The PR's own CI (analyze + tests + CRAP/loc guards) is the real gate.** Risk areas called out for review: pattern-shadowing in mapForeignSession (legal Dart 3, but the analyzer will confirm), and the CRAP score of the 9-case mapper switch (mirrors SessionRecord.fromJson's 15-case shape).

{"content":"💡 SUGGESTION (oversized claude files vanish at discovery) — **implemented rather than deferred**; the reporting parity now holds on every backend, for both adapters.

**Fix** (`lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart`, `discover`): when a file is over `ImportLimits.maxFileBytes`, `_firstCwd` returns `''` on backends without partial reads (the size gate keeps the whole-file read bounded). Discovery now recognizes exactly that case (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) and still emits the summary — cwd unverified — instead of dropping it. The read-time refusal in `scanForeignLines` then produces the counted warning through the runner:

```
warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)
```

so `fa import --all` over a bucket of oversized claude files no longer reports `no claude sessions found` — it names every file and the size reason, like omp.

**Same pattern swept across the codebase** (`lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart`, `discover`): omp had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class — its ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files (bounded 4096-byte prefix, uncapped by design) but its non-ranged fallback returned null → `continue` → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. Ranged backends are untouched: the prefix read still resolves the real header (id/cwd) and the summary construction is byte-identical there.

**Tests** (`test/import/adapter_size_parity_test.dart`, new): a `_NoRangeEnv` capability-stripping wrapper (the `_NoRenameEnv` decorator pattern — `FileSystem` without `RangedReadFileSystem`, the web-shell backend class) pins, for both adapters: (1) over-cap discovery still yields the summary (`sourceId 'big'`), (2) `read` refuses with `ForeignFileError('file too large …')`, (3) the runner emits `warning: skipped big: … file too large …` and imports nothing (exit 3). All three failed before the fix with exactly the reported symptom (`import: no claude sessions found for <cwd>`) and pass after.

warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)

**Fix** (`lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart`, `discover`): when a file is over `ImportLimits.maxFileBytes`, `_firstCwd` returns `''` on backends without partial reads (the size gate keeps the whole-file read bounded). Discovery now recognizes exactly that case (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) and still emits the summary — cwd unverified — instead of dropping it. The read-time refusal in `scanForeignLines` then produces the counted warning through the runner:

```
warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)
```

so `fa import --all` over a bucket of oversized claude files no longer reports `no claude sessions found` — it names every file and the size reason, like omp.

**Same pattern swept across the codebase** (`lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart`, `discover`): omp had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class — its ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files (bounded 4096-byte prefix, uncapped by design) but its non-ranged fallback returned null → `continue` → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. Ranged backends are untouched: the prefix read still resolves the real header (id/cwd) and the summary construction is byte-identical there.

{"content":"💡 SUGGESTION (oversized claude files vanish at discovery) — **implemented rather than deferred**; the reporting parity now holds on every backend, for both adapters.

**Fix** (`lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart`, `discover`): when a file is over `ImportLimits.maxFileBytes`, `_firstCwd` returns `''` on backends without partial reads (the size gate keeps the whole-file read bounded). Discovery now recognizes exactly that case (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) and still emits the summary — cwd unverified — instead of dropping it. The read-time refusal in `scanForeignLines` then produces the counted warning through the runner:

```
warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)
```

so `fa import --all` over a bucket of oversized claude files no longer reports `no claude sessions found` — it names every file and the size reason, like omp.

**Same pattern swept across the codebase** (`lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart`, `discover`): omp had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class — its ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files (bounded 4096-byte prefix, uncapped by design) but its non-ranged fallback returned null → `continue` → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. Ranged backends are untouched: the prefix read still resolves the real header (id/cwd) and the summary construction is byte-identical there.

# PR #1563 rework — oversized-file discovery parity (open thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rfkSE`)

## Issues/Notes

- One open review thread remained on this round: the carried SUGGESTION that **oversized claude files vanish at discovery** instead of refusing with the counted `file too large` warning omp produces — `fa import --all` over such a bucket reported `no claude sessions found` (exit 3) with the files' existence and size reason invisible.
- Root cause: on backends without partial reads, `_firstCwd`'s size gate (added in `cbfe10227` to bound the whole-file fallback) returns `''`, the cwd-match fails, and the file never becomes a summary. The ranged path (the real CLI) was already correct — it reads the bounded 4096-byte prefix uncapped, discovers the file, and refuses at read time. The gap was the non-ranged backend class (web shell shape).
- No merge conflicts; `ci_failures.md` reports all CI checks green on the rework head. This pass changes no CI surface.

## Approach

- `lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart` (`discover`): an over-cap file whose cwd probe came back empty (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) now **still becomes a summary** (cwd unverified) instead of being dropped — `scanForeignLines`' read-time refusal then produces the counted warning through the runner:
  `warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)`.
- Same pattern swept across the codebase — `lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart` (`discover`) had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class: ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files, but its non-ranged fallback returned null → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. **Ranged backends are byte-for-byte unchanged**: the prefix read still resolves the real header, and matched summaries carry the same id/cwd/title as before.
- Reporting parity is now uniform: an oversized session file is never silently invisible, on any backend, for either adapter.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart` — over-cap discovery parity (sentinel-cwd summary).
- `lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart` — mirrored over-cap discovery parity (stem-id summary fallback).
- `test/import/adapter_size_parity_test.dart` — new UT tier (see below).
- `outputs/review_replies.json` + `outputs/review_replies/thread_26.md` — reply to the open thread.

## Test Coverage

TDD (RED → GREEN), per the rework discipline:

- **RED**: `test/import/adapter_size_parity_test.dart` adds a `_NoRangeEnv` capability-stripping wrapper (`FileSystem` without `RangedReadFileSystem` — the `_NoRenameEnv` decorator pattern, modeling the web-shell backend) and pins, for **both** adapters:
  1. over-cap discovery still yields the summary (`sourceId 'big'`),
  2. `read` refuses with `ForeignFileError` carrying `file too large`,
  3. the runner emits `warning: skipped big: … file too large …`, imports nothing, exits 3.
  All three failed pre-fix with exactly the reported symptom (`import: no claude sessions found for <cwd>`) and pass post-fix.
- Full import + REG tier after the fix: **61 passed, 1 skipped** (`test/import`, `test/skills/cli_parity_test.dart`, `test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart`; the machine-gated E2E skips as designed). `dart analyze` on the three touched files: no issues. Full `dart test` suite run recorded in this pass's verification (see ledger).

## Verification

- `dart analyze lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart test/import/adapter_size_parity_test.dart` → No issues found.
- `dart test test/import test/skills/cli_parity_test.dart test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart` → 61 passed, 1 skipped (machine-gated E2E), 0 failed.
- Full suite `dart test` → green (0 failures; see task ledger for the exact tail).

**Fix** (`lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart`, `discover`): when a file is over `ImportLimits.maxFileBytes`, `_firstCwd` returns `''` on backends without partial reads (the size gate keeps the whole-file read bounded). Discovery now recognizes exactly that case (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) and still emits the summary — cwd unverified — instead of dropping it. The read-time refusal in `scanForeignLines` then produces the counted warning through the runner:

```
warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)
```

so `fa import --all` over a bucket of oversized claude files no longer reports `no claude sessions found` — it names every file and the size reason, like omp.

**Same pattern swept across the codebase** (`lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart`, `discover`): omp had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class — its ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files (bounded 4096-byte prefix, uncapped by design) but its non-ranged fallback returned null → `continue` → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. Ranged backends are untouched: the prefix read still resolves the real header (id/cwd) and the summary construction is byte-identical there.

All three failed before the fix with exactly the reported symptom (`import: no claude sessions found for <cwd>`) and pass after.

{"content":"💡 SUGGESTION (oversized claude files vanish at discovery) — **implemented rather than deferred**; the reporting parity now holds on every backend, for both adapters.

**Fix** (`lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart`, `discover`): when a file is over `ImportLimits.maxFileBytes`, `_firstCwd` returns `''` on backends without partial reads (the size gate keeps the whole-file read bounded). Discovery now recognizes exactly that case (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) and still emits the summary — cwd unverified — instead of dropping it. The read-time refusal in `scanForeignLines` then produces the counted warning through the runner:

```
warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)
```

so `fa import --all` over a bucket of oversized claude files no longer reports `no claude sessions found` — it names every file and the size reason, like omp.

**Same pattern swept across the codebase** (`lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart`, `discover`): omp had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class — its ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files (bounded 4096-byte prefix, uncapped by design) but its non-ranged fallback returned null → `continue` → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. Ranged backends are untouched: the prefix read still resolves the real header (id/cwd) and the summary construction is byte-identical there.

{"content":"# PR #1563 rework — oversized-file discovery parity (open thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rfkSE`)

## Issues/Notes

- One open review thread remained on this round: the carried SUGGESTION that **oversized claude files vanish at discovery** instead of refusing with the counted `file too large` warning omp produces — `fa import --all` over such a bucket reported `no claude sessions found` (exit 3) with the files' existence and size reason invisible.
- Root cause: on backends without partial reads, `_firstCwd`'s size gate (added in `cbfe10227` to bound the whole-file fallback) returns `''`, the cwd-match fails, and the file never becomes a summary. The ranged path (the real CLI) was already correct — it reads the bounded 4096-byte prefix uncapped, discovers the file, and refuses at read time. The gap was the non-ranged backend class (web shell shape).

## Approach

- `lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart` (`discover`): an over-cap file whose cwd probe came back empty (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) now **still becomes a summary** (cwd unverified) instead of being dropped — `scanForeignLines`' read-time refusal then produces the counted warning through the runner:
  `warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)`.
- Same pattern swept across the codebase — `lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart` (`discover`) had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class: ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files, but its non-ranged fallback returned null → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. **Ranged backends are byte-for-byte unchanged**: the prefix read still resolves the real header, and matched summaries carry the same id/cwd/title as before.
- Reporting parity is now uniform: an oversized session file is never silently invisible, on any backend, for either adapter.

warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)
```

so `fa import --all` over a bucket of oversized claude files no longer reports `no claude sessions found` — it names every file and the size reason, like omp.

Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. {"content":"# PR #1563 rework — oversized-file discovery parity (open thread `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6rfkSE`)

## Issues/Notes

- One open review thread remained on this round: the carried SUGGESTION that **oversized claude files vanish at discovery** instead of refusing with the counted `file too large` warning omp produces — `fa import --all` over such a bucket reported `no claude sessions found` (exit 3) with the files' existence and size reason invisible.
- Root cause: on backends without partial reads, `_firstCwd`'s size gate (added in `cbfe10227` to bound the whole-file fallback) returns `''`, the cwd-match fails, and the file never becomes a summary. The ranged path (the real CLI) was already correct — it reads the bounded 4096-byte prefix uncapped, discovers the file, and refuses at read time. The gap was the non-ranged backend class (web shell shape).
- No merge conflicts; `ci_failures.md` reports all CI checks green on the rework head. This pass changes no CI surface.

## Approach

- `lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart` (`discover`): an over-cap file whose cwd probe came back empty (`headerCwd.isEmpty && size > limits.maxFileBytes`) now **still becomes a summary** (cwd unverified) instead of being dropped — `scanForeignLines`' read-time refusal then produces the counted warning through the runner:
  `warning: skipped <id>: file too large: <n> bytes (limit <n>)`.
- Same pattern swept across the codebase — `lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart` (`discover`) had the mirror-image gap on the same backend class: ranged `_readPrefix` discovers oversized files, but its non-ranged fallback returned null → silent vanish. Now an over-cap file with no header within the cap also becomes a summary (id fallback: the file stem, cwd unverified) and refuses at read time with the same counted warning. **Ranged backends are byte-for-byte unchanged**: the prefix read still resolves the real header, and matched summaries carry the same id/cwd/title as before.
- Reporting parity is now uniform: an oversized session file is never silently invisible, on any backend, for either adapter.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart` — over-cap discovery parity (sentinel-cwd summary).
- `lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart` — mirrored over-cap discovery parity (stem-id summary fallback).
- `test/import/adapter_size_parity_test.dart` — new UT tier (see below).
- `outputs/review_replies.json` + `outputs/review_replies/thread_26.md` — reply to the open thread.

## Test Coverage

TDD (RED → GREEN), per the rework discipline:

- **RED**: `test/import/adapter_size_parity_test.dart` adds a `_NoRangeEnv` capability-stripping wrapper (`FileSystem` without `RangedReadFileSystem` — the `_NoRenameEnv` decorator pattern, modeling the web-shell backend) and pins, for **both** adapters:
  1. over-cap discovery still yields the summary (`sourceId 'big'`),
  2. `read` refuses with `ForeignFileError` carrying `file too large`,
  3. the runner emits `warning: skipped big: … file too large …`, imports nothing, exits 3.
  All three failed pre-fix with exactly the reported symptom (`import: no claude sessions found for <cwd>`) and pass post-fix.
- Full import + REG tier after the fix: **61 passed, 1 skipped** (`test/import`, `test/skills/cli_parity_test.dart`, `test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart`; the machine-gated E2E skips as designed). `dart analyze` on the three touched files: no issues. Full `dart test` suite run recorded in this pass's verification (see ledger).

## Verification

- `dart analyze lib/src/import/claude_adapter.dart lib/src/import/omp_adapter.dart test/import/adapter_size_parity_test.dart` → No issues found.
- `dart test test/import test/skills/cli_parity_test.dart test/cli/add_provider_picker_test.dart` → 61 passed, 1 skipped (machine-gated E2E), 0 failed.
- Full suite `dart test` → green (0 failures; see task ledger for the exact tail).

- uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: coverage-shard-*
          path: coverage-shards

      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o coverage/lcov.info coverage-shards/*/lcov.info

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the
          # coverage source; gates must not re-run the suite.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 — analyzer 7.3→14.4 refresh + the
          # duplication.sources key (native cross-module scan).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

      # Issue #1234 rework: 0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override (a
      # gates.loc.sources key is a ConfigException — caught here on
      # 019ede65), and the package config's sources drive the CRAP census
      # too, so test/ + example/ get the SAME loc gate from the companion
      # config (crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml) — the scope the retired shell
      # guards (gh-1232) scanned there. No baseline: nothing exceeds 2800
      # today, and the ceiling itself is the point.
      - name: Loc scope gate (test/ + example/, gh-1232 whole-tree ceiling)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --config crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml --only loc

      - name: Duplication guard (lib/ < 1%)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          npx --yes jscpd@5 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 5 --reporters json \
            --output /tmp/jscpd-ci lib/ || true
          python3 - <<'EOF'
          import json, sys
          try:
              with open('/tmp/jscpd-ci/jscpd-report.json') as f:
                  pct = json.load(f)['statistics']['total']['percentage']
          except Exception:
              pct = 0.0
          print(f'Duplication: {pct}% (threshold < 1.0%)')
          sys.exit(0 if float(pct) < 1.0 else 1)
          EOF

      # Issue #487: cross-module duplication gate (issue body measured 20
      # files shipped as app↔core/fa_ui/browser_ext clones). Runs the SAME
      # stage the pre-commit hook runs — one marker, parity diffable. The
      # app leg matters: most cross-module clones are born on the app side
      # and the CRAP/dup steps above stay core/shared-scoped.
      - name: Cross-module duplication ratchet (issue #487)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true'
        run: scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh --stages dupx
